ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity (white) and 35% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe presents a dense, heterogeneous mottling of low-intensity pixels concentrated along the leading edge and central fluke body. Right lobe is predominantly high-intensity white, featuring a large contiguous low-intensity patch at the distal tip and isolated focal spots in the medial region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central junction; approximately 40-45 degree convergence with a deep bounding-box recession relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes; extreme distal tip of the right lobe exhibits a high-amplitude, irregular textural disruption consisting of non-linear jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending from the medial notch to the distal tips, following a broad parabolic arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, roughly circular low-contrast clusters (dark on white) visible in the lower-central quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (dark rake-like marks) visible on the mid-to-distal section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable brownish-red bulbous mass and irregular tissue texture located at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe, indicating significant localized trauma or biological growth.
other_distinctive_markers: Water droplet occlusion and splash spray at the basal junction where the fluke meets the water line, masking fine detail in the lower-central region.
